basics.name: Amir Ata Ghaffarian
basics.label: Research Intern, OIST · Machine Learning & Genomics
basics.summary: Machine-learning researcher with an engineering background. At OIST I apply self-supervised learning and graph neural networks to genomic data; before that I worked in DevOps, SRE and backend engineering.

Multimodal representations of pairwise genome alignments to find structural variation at scale.
End-to-end HPC pipeline with Slurm and Singularity.

projects.name: Goal-Space Planning, reproduced (gsp-fourrooms)
projects.summary: From-scratch tabular reproduction of Goal-Space Planning with Subgoal Models (Lo et al., JMLR 2024) on FourRooms, with exact subgoal models and an [interactive report](https://amirata051.github.io/gsp-fourrooms/report/).
highlights: 8 experiments reproduced in about 3 minutes on one CPU core; GSP halves the episodes Sarsa(λ) needs to reach near-optimal (35 → 18).
Documents three open discrepancies with the paper, with candidate causes.

projects.name: MyTorch — Deep Learning Framework
projects.summary: From-scratch NumPy autodiff and neural-network framework with a PyTorch-like API: forward- and reverse-mode AD, optimizers, training diagnostics and run tracking.
highlights: Built with an agentic coding partner; every change validated by 1,200+ tests, gradient checks, strict type/lint gates and multi-version CI.

projects.name: Knowledge Graph Generator
